WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_film_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_film_ratio,
  film_count,
  avg_film_ratio - AVG(avg_film_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_rating_average
FROM rating_averages;

assumptions.assumption: The plain average means the unweighted average of the five rating-level averages, so each rating contributes equally.
